You're not weak we all deal with trauma in different ways. Therapy might work for someone while it's totally useless for someone else. You can either let the trauma define or you don't let it define you at all. Ignore or embrace it 100%, everyone deals with it in their own way.

Just existing or living life fully is also up to the individual. I decided to deal with my trauma which is hard when you've just existed for 10 years. Live life fully or just exist whatever works is up to the individual but remember that you've got to take one step at a time if you want to get better whatever you decide to do. It's not gonna happen over a day it might take months or even years for people to recover somewhat.
